data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Bethesda, meaning house of mercy or God is gracious. This name is often associated with the biblical story of the pool of Bethesda, where Jesus healed a man who had been an invalid for thirty-eight years. The name Betteann carries the meaning “God is gracious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Betteann total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: בטאן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם בטאן הוא שילוב של שתי מילים עבריות: 'אלוהים' ו-'בטא', שפירושו הבטחה או שבועה. השם נגזר מהשורש העברי 'בטא' שפירושו להיות בטוח או נאמן. הוא משקף את המחויבות והנאמנות לאלוהים.

in_greek.name: Μπετεάνν
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μπετεάνν είναι σύνθεση δύο ελληνικών λέξεων: 'Θεός' και 'υπόσχεση'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, η υπόσχεση του Θεού είναι ένα επαναλαμβανόμενο θέμα. Το όνομα αντανακλά την πίστη και την εμπιστοσύνη στο Θεό.

in_latin.name: Betteann
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Betteann derivatur ex hebraicis et graecis radicibus, significans 'Deus est mea promissio'. In Ecclesia primitiva, promissio Dei habebat magnam significationem. Nomen hoc reflectit devotionem et fidem in Deum.

data.spiritual_significance: Named after the Hebrew term Bethesda, meaning 'house of God's mercy,' the name "Betteann" is steeped in spiritual significance. This name can be an inspiration for those who bear it to live their lives with gratitude, compassion, and humility, striving to extend God's grace and mercy to others in their daily lives.
